references.text: Used to illustrate how good deeds result in good outcomes, and evil deeds in evil outcomes, just as a tree is known by its fruit.
Shows how the righteous will thrive like a tree, in contrast to the wicked who will not.
Highlights the importance of the fruits of one's labor and how they reflect a person's character.
Draws parallels to sowing and reaping as an image of the consequences of our actions.
Lists the fruit of the Spirit, which are good character traits that can be compared to the good tree and its good fruit.
